record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical relativity
record.original_question: Can one prove existence of the non-singular, asymptotically flat, static, spherically symmetric Einstein-Yang-Mills solutions that had been observed numerically?

evidence.quote: Recently it has been shown numerically that the static, spherically symmetric Einstein-Yang-Mills (EYM) equations have non-singular, AF solutions [BM]. This raises many interesting questions, for example: (i) prove existence of the static spherically symmetric EYM solutions;

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the static, spherically symmetric Einstein–Yang–Mills (EYM) system with gauge group SU(2). The spacetime metric is taken in the form
  ds^2 = -T(r)^{-2} dt^2 + A(r)^{-1} dr^2 + r^2 (dθ^2 + sin^2 θ dφ^2),
and the Yang–Mills connection is described by a single function w(r) (the magnetic ansatz), giving the coupled ODE system
  r A' + (1 - A) = -(1 - w^2)^2 / r^2 - 2 A (w')^2,
  2 r A (T'/T) = (1 - A) - (1 - w^2)^2 / r^2 + 2 A (w')^2 - 1,
  r^2 A w'' + [r(1 - A) - (1 - w^2)^2 / r] w' + w(1 - w^2) = 0.
A solution is called non-singular at the origin if A(0) = 1 and w(0) = 1 with w'(0) = 0, and asymptotically flat if A(r) → 1, T(r) → 1, and w(r) → ±1 as r → ∞ (so that the ADM mass is finite).

Prove rigorously that there exist non-singular, asymptotically flat, globally defined solutions (T, A, w) of this system on [0, ∞). In particular, establish the analytic existence of the particle-like solutions whose existence has been observed numerically.
artifact.status_search_result: The existence of non-singular, asymptotically flat, static, spherically symmetric SU(2) Einstein–Yang–Mills solutions (the Bartnik–McKinnon solitons) was established rigorously by Smoller, Wasserman, Yau, and McLeod in the early 1990s, proving the existence of infinitely many smooth global solutions and analytically confirming the numerical observations.

status_evidence.title: Static Spherically Symmetric Solutions of the Einstein-Yang-Mills Equations
status_evidence.snippet: Smoller and Wasserman proved the existence of infinitely many smooth, static, global solutions of the Einstein/Yang-Mills equations.
status_evidence.claim: Analytic existence proof of the Bartnik–McKinnon particle-like solutions.

status_evidence.title: Analysis of the static spherically symmetric SU(n)-Einstein-Yang-Mills equations
status_evidence.snippet: Analysis classifying static spherically symmetric EYM solutions including Bartnik-McKinnon type.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent rigorous analyses confirm and extend the existence result.
